entities.summary: Alejandra de la Guerra is a Peruvian former volleyball player who won the silver medal with the Peruvian women's national volleyball team at the 1988 Summer Olympics in Seoul. De la Guerra also helped the Peruvian team to the silver medal at the 1987 Pan American Games in Indianapolis, Indiana.
